# GridCraft

Spreadsheet engine used by 1S to read .xls/.xlsx/.ods and write .xlsx
(`src/migrate/gridcraft.py`, the `/demo/sverka` page, `migrate reconcile`).

- Source: https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft (tag v0.8.0)
- Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE in this folder)
- Shipped as a separate executable, `bin/gridcraft-cli`; 1S calls it as a process.
